record.title: Marty Gots a Plan
record.instruments: Cello, Viola, Violin, English Horn, Alto Flute, Percussion, Marimba
record.description: Sneaking around the house? Use this! Planning a comedic caper? Also good! Semi-random pizzicato is like magic for cheeky hijinks. You know... when Marty gots a plan, it aint usually a good one.
